values: For the whole filled pillow including casing and seams: normal machine wash at maximum60°C; then tumble dry at maximum60°C until the filling is completely dry. Line-only drying is not allowed. Do not bleach, iron or dry-clean. The permanently attached casing cannot be washed separately.

Remove the supplied outer cover through its zipper. Wash that cover alone on a normal machine cycle at maximum40°C; line dry. Do not bleach, tumble dry, iron or dry-clean the cover. Do not wash, immerse, bleach, tumble dry, iron or dry-clean the core; air it dry without soaking. Do not machine wash the assembled pillow.
